format: C# (ASP.NET code-behind for an ASPX page)
description: This file is a code-behind class for an ASP.NET Web Forms page that facilitates creating and managing multiple-choice questions (MCQs) for an online examination system. It includes event handlers for UI interactions such as selecting courses and semesters, adding questions to a database, setting up exams, and navigating between pages.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: A partial class representing the code-behind for the online exam question setup page, handling user interactions, database operations, and navigation for creating and managing MCQ exams.
